text:
Alex Kim: quick sync — UX decision: when the primary model crosses error thresholds should we surface a visible 'switchover' banner to end-users or keep silent and route behind the scenes? Need opinions from telemetry & product.
Priya Shah: my instinct: visible banner for enterprise pages, with link to 'realtime status' and 'why' — helps support triage
Ben O'Connor: +1 for visibility, but only if we can attach confidence and rollback link. otherwise we'll cause panic.
Emily Zhou: telemetry: we currently emit model_5xx_rate, p95_latency, and kv_cache_miss. For auto-switchover we need a composite signal: rolling 1m 5xx > 2% AND spike in p99 latency > 200ms OR throughput drop > 30%
Carlos Mendez: can we add a soft-switch mode? route 10% to fallback model first, keep banner internal-only until success
Alex Kim: sketch: 1) detect -> 2) opt-in 'staged switchover' (traffic ramp) -> 3) if regen metrics good, escalate to full swap -> 4) audit log + notif
Priya Shah: what should the banner text be? 'We're switching models for reliability — responses may change' + link to docs
Ben O'Connor: also need admin override in Console -> 'force rollback' and audit trail (who clicked, reason)
Emily Zhou: example policy snippet:
```
policy: {
  trigger: {metric: 'model_5xx_rate', window: '60s', threshold: 0.02},
  ramp: {initial_pct: 10, step: 20, interval_s: 60},
  success_criteria: {p99_latency: '<200ms', 5xx_rate: '<1%'}
}
```
Carlos Mendez: +1. Also add 'blacklist' for customers with strict model pinning — don't auto-switchover
Alex Kim: audit requirements: every automatic switchover must create an immutable event with: policy_id, triggers, metric_snapshot, before_model, after_model, user_override (if any), deployment_id
Priya Shah: retention: keep audit for 90 days by default, option for 1y for enterprise
Ben O'Connor: telemetry: tag traces with rollout_id and decision_path so we can slice errors by rollout
Emily Zhou: we'll need extra dashboards: one for 'in-progress ramp' with per-customer success rates
Carlos Mendez: UX: show per-customer status in Console -> tiny status chip: Active/Staged/Rolled-back, and link to trace
Alex Kim: accessibility: if banner is shown we must not expose details of infra — short copy + link to internal logs only for admins
Priya Shah: content for support emails? auto-generate: subject 'Model switched for reliability' body with short bullet + rollback ETA
Ben O'Connor: security note: ensure KMS keys not rotated during rollback window
rollout-bot: [automated] Created rollout event rlt_20260320_01 for policy pol_45 (staged) — triggered by metric spike
Carlos Mendez: can we add 'canary by customer segment' — e.g., exclude top-tier customers unless approved
Alex Kim: ok action items: Emily to prototype policy DSL + dashboard tiles, Carlos to mock Console chip, Priya to draft copy & support flow, Ben to spec audit schema
Emily Zhou: assigning Emily -> PR for telemetry in 2d, will add rollout_id tagging
Ben O'Connor: I'll draft audit schema doc and put in /docs/rollouts by EOD
Priya Shah: I'll prepare crisper banner copy and support templates
Alex Kim: thanks team. I'll sync with legal on retention. tagging @ops to FYI :eyes: 
deploy-bot: deployment complete: telemetry/service v2.1 -> canary started
Carlos Mendez: noted, will add customer-seg exclude toggle
Emily Zhou: any objections to default ramp steps? initial 5%, then 25% after 60s, then 100% after 3m if green
Ben O'Connor: fine by me
Alex Kim: sounds good. closing thread, filing spec ticket RD-4523
Priya Shah: :thumbsup:
